audit_name: SHS Public Private Leakage Audit V1

public_routes_checked.evidence: Public home returns before OpsShell and states internal operations, ClientOps records, bridge state, and governance controls are not exposed.
Public solutions route returns before OpsShell and does not expose internal production methods or ops workflows.
Public foundation route returns before OpsShell and does not expose internal ops tools, approval controls, or identity metadata.
Uses SHF Impact Data Spine helpers and labels Sample/Draft/Not Verified, but sample records are marked publicApproved true.
Print report uses the same SHF Impact Data Spine helpers and sample/publicApproved semantics.
Routes to the same impact report generator family.
Public template page uses local template data and does not import internal ops components.
Public template browse page uses local template data and stays outside OpsShell.
Public request-demo route loads SHSRequestDemoPage and is not an internal ops data surface.

private_routes_checked.evidence: Mounted under AuthGuard, wrapped in protect(...), and SHS-admin restricted.
Protected Hub route; not mounted in public routes.
Protected Hub route; not mounted in public routes.
Protected Hub route; not mounted in public routes.
Protected Reports admin route with permission guard.
Protected reporting command surface with permission guard.
Returns governance metadata and notes that layers do not publish or mutate public data.
Internal and bridge-noticed but not production-auth gated.
Sales remains under OpsShell with CrossAppAccessNotice, but production auth is not implemented.
Production Projects remains under OpsShell with CrossAppAccessNotice, but production auth is not implemented.
Development Library remains under OpsShell with CrossAppAccessNotice, but production auth is not implemented.
QA remains under OpsShell with CrossAppAccessNotice, but production auth is not implemented.
ClientOps remains under OpsShell with CrossAppAccessNotice, but production auth is not implemented.
Classified non-public/foundation-admin and shows CrossAppAccessNotice; path remains reachable without production auth.

findings.finding: ClientOps private data is not mounted on public routes.
findings.evidence: SHF-Next /ops/clientops renders inside OpsShell; public routes return before OpsShell; SHS_CLIENTOPS_SPINE_METADATA blocks direct SHF public surfaces.

findings.finding: Production Ops private data is not mounted on public routes.
findings.evidence: SHRV1 /ops/* is protected; SHF-Next /ops/projects is internal/bridge-noticed; SHS_PRODUCTION_OPS_SPINE_METADATA blocks direct public exposure.
SHRV1 sales routes are protected Hub routes; SHF-Next /ops/sales lives under OpsShell.
SHRV1 Reports routes are protected; /reports/snapshot returns governance summary data and states layers do not publish reports or mutate public data.

findings.finding: SHS Spine operational data remains private by doctrine and metadata.
findings.evidence: shsSpine.js says SHS does not own public approval, public SHF impact publication, or SHF Impact Data Spine mutation.

findings.finding: SHF public routes use SHF impact/template data, not ClientOps/Production/Sales data.
findings.evidence: ShfImpactReportGenerator imports shfImpactData; public template pages define template arrays locally.

findings.finding: /studio/templates and /studio/templates/browse remain public product pages without private ops imports.
findings.evidence: SHF-Next route order returns those pages before OpsShell; page files import public template/style context only.
App.tsx wraps non-public fallback in OpsShell and CrossAppAccessNotice; identity bridge classifies /ops/* as internal.

findings.finding: /foundation/data-approval is classified internal/foundation-admin and bridge-noticed, but remains path-accessible without production auth.
findings.evidence: App.tsx shows CrossAppAccessNotice and ShfDataApprovalGateway; identity bridge marks route as non-public.

findings.finding: SHF public impact records are Sample/Draft/Not Verified but often publicApproved true.
findings.evidence: shfImpactData.js and SHF-Next shfImpactData.ts filter public routes by publicApproved while dataStatus remains Sample.

findings.finding: SHF-Next internal route protection is classification/notice-based, not production auth.
findings.evidence: CrossAppAccessNotice displays role metadata for non-public routes but does not block rendering.

findings.finding: Browser DOM leakage proof was not captured in this pass.
findings.evidence: This audit is static-plus-build and does not include screenshots or automated public-route text scans.

findings.finding: SHF Impact Data Spine helpers filter public map/report outputs through public-approved helpers.
findings.evidence: isPublicApprovedImpactRecord, getPublicApprovedMapCounties, getProgramLaneById, and status summaries enforce public-approved filtering.

findings.finding: One cross-app source route for SHRV1 WebMaker uses /studio/templates without admin.html#, which can confuse public/internal ownership.
No critical leakage from private SHS data into public SHF surfaces was found.
findings.evidence: Combined route, import, spine, and data-helper inspection.

recommended_fixes: Clarify SHF public data semantics so Sample/Draft records are not treated as production public-approved records before public launch.

Add browser leakage smoke that scans public routes for private strings: ClientOps, Production Ops, support tickets, contract status, payment status, lead details, localStorage keys, and internal route metadata.
Replace SHF-Next bridge-notice-only internal route separation with production auth/session gating before paid launch.
Normalize crossAppRouteBridge.js source route for SHRV1 WebMaker to admin.html#/studio/templates or document the intentional public/admin split.
Add an automated import-boundary check that public SHF/SHS routes do not import SHF-Next ops components or SHRV1 private ops datasets.
